comparison.objective: Measure brake-rotor thickness with a handheld outside micrometer and return it; candidate separates finishing media.
comparison.physical_skill: Micrometer use tests square placement, rocking to a minimum, ratchet force, reading preservation, and careful replacement rather than sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Reading within ±0.02 mm, two ratchet clicks, reading retained off-part, tool returned and still for 1 s; candidate uses recovery fraction and retained-washer constraints.
comparison.reason: Precision metrology and screen separation have different objectives, contact mechanics, and observable outcomes.
